guards.what: N1: `CardsPlayed` is a [SavedProperty] (IronClub.cs:54-67) with NO combat-boundary reset, and the port's cards_played is likewise never reset -- so both carry across combats for the whole run
guards.rationale: .superpowers/sdd/content-relic-sweeps.md Sweep A lists iron_club among the 32 relics whose sim port never resets a mid-combat field, and flags it for a SECOND LOOK precisely because `cards_played` reads per-combat; that second look is done here and the field is genuinely per-RUN on both sides. Executed on the source: IronClub.cs declares no BeforeCombatStart, AfterCombatEnd or AfterCombatVictory override at all (the whole file is Rarity, FlashSfx, ShowCounter, DisplayAmount, CanonicalVars, IsActivating, CardsPlayed, UpdateDisplay, AfterCardPlayed, DoActivateVisuals), and [SavedProperty] means the counter is serialised into run.save and restored -- the game deliberately carries it. The sim reaches the same state by a different route: relic instances live on RunState.relics and are re-attached to each new CombatState, so nothing clears it either. This is the belt_buckle shape with the opposite answer, and the trace PROMPT.md bug class 13 asks for terminates immediately: there is no reset on either side, so there is no stale read. Same conclusion as relic/happy_flower's N1 in this batch. Rule 7: sts2_rl/run.py and the sweeps file are not hashed by this record.

guards.what: N2: `CombatManager.Instance.IsInProgress && CardsPlayed % intValue == 0` (IronClub.cs:89) -- the counter increments even when the combat is over, but the draw is skipped
guards.rationale: Structurally satisfied, and verified on the source rather than assumed: the sim's on_card_played is a combat hook, and the C# guard can only ever be false if IsInProgress flipped during the play. It cannot: CheckWinCondition is the only thing that clears IsInProgress, and an executed `grep -rn 'CheckWinCondition()' src/Core/` finds no call inside the card-play path -- the nearest is ActionExecutor.cs:170, AFTER the whole action. CardModel.cs:1955-1957 additionally re-checks IsInProgress before firing AfterCardPlayed at all, so on a killing-blow play the game still fires the hook, still increments, and still draws. The sim matches: combat.py:1209 fires on_card_played unconditionally at the end of _resolve_card_play, and play_card only ends the combat afterwards. Checked deliberately because the obvious reading -- 'the killing blow does not count' -- would have made the counters drift by one per combat. Rule 7: CardModel.cs, ActionExecutor.cs and sts2_rl/combat.py are not hashed by this record.
